type: research-only retrospective review; not a completed exhaustive annual source audit
publicationStatus: Eleven schema-valid local drafts only. No content, Supabase, state checkpoints, or issue records were changed.
scope: High-consequence ED studies and official guidance. Separate historical collection; exclude from ordinary new-week briefs. Root must add historical metadata before any publication.

completeness.reason: Focused major-trial and separate society discovery found strong candidates, but no all-results four-source PubMed annual query pagination was completed. Several official manual-check organizations and major journal archives still need systematic review. Do not advance normal discovery checkpoints.

reviewMethod: Original summaries from primary publisher/PubMed abstracts or official society summaries. Search tool sometimes returned complete indexed primary abstracts when direct public opens encountered 403 or reCAPTCHA. These were reviewed conservatively as abstracts, never as completed full-text review. No third-party PDF, paid resource, or paywall bypass was used. Full-text availability and material actually reviewed remain separate article fields.
